scope: 154-claim fixed official dev split; deterministic five-fold hash cross-fitting; not independent test generalisation
decision: Reject both routers as a replacement for the always-4B offline quality profile. The agreement router is a statistically positive intermediate cost-quality point versus RRF but preserves only 36% of the 4B Evidence-F1 gain, below the predeclared 80% target. Adding hashed claim-text features worsened generalisation and is a verified negative result.
latency_boundary: Estimated means combine the measured HNSW weak-path time with the measured 4B reranker mean multiplied by cross-fit call rate. They are analytical estimates, not new end-to-end load-test P95 values.
data_boundary: Restricted claims, evidence, predictions and large model artifacts remain on Spartan. This compact record contains aggregate metrics and hashes only.
